title: Kirk McConnell and extended electrodynamics
place_text: Senate Armed Services Committee, Washington DC

tellings.quote: So he's Senate Armed Services Committee and he was under Jack Reid um the senator from Rhode Island and he knows all about extended electronamics

plain: A Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell, who worked for the Senate Armed Services Committee, the group of senators that oversees the military, "knows all about extended electrodynamics", according to Jesse Michels. That is an idea that goes beyond standard physics of electricity and magnetism, which some link to how unexplained craft might fly. Michels says McConnell worked under Jack Reid, the senator from Rhode Island, and tells this himself without naming a source, hinting that such physics is understood inside Congress.
